tools.name: -health-check
tools.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies Homey API credentials and connectivity.

tools.name: homey-get-user
tools.description: Get authenticated user information from Homey

tools.name: homey-list-devices
tools.description: List all devices connected to Homey with their zone, class, capabilities, and availability status

tools.name: homey-get-device
tools.description: Get detailed information and current state of a specific Homey device by ID

tools.name: homey-set-capability
tools.description: Set a device capability value (e.g., turn on/off, set brightness, temperature). Use homey-list-devices to find device IDs and capabilities.

value.description: Value to set (boolean for onoff, number 0-1 for dim, number for temperature)

tools.name: homey-list-flows
tools.description: List all flows (automations) configured in Homey

tools.name: homey-trigger-flow
tools.description: Trigger (run) a Homey flow by its ID

tools.name: homey-list-zones
tools.description: List all zones (rooms/areas) configured in Homey

tools.name: homey-get-system-info
tools.description: Get Homey system information including firmware version, model, uptime, Wi-Fi status, and more

tools.name: homey-list-notifications
tools.description: List notifications from Homey (alerts, warnings, system messages)

tools.name: homey-get-variables
tools.description: List all logic variables configured in Homey. Logic variables are used in flows/automations for state tracking.

tools.name: homey-set-variable
tools.description: Set the value of a Homey logic variable by its ID. Use homey-get-variables to find variable IDs.

value.description: New value for the variable (string, number, or boolean — must match the variable type)

tools.name: homey-list-apps
tools.description: List all apps installed on Homey. Useful for diagnostics and checking which integrations are active.

tools.name: homey-get-energy
tools.description: Get live energy report from Homey including current power usage and generation across the home

zone.description: Optional zone ID to filter energy data for a specific zone
